scope.purpose: Raw factual direct-viewing notes only; not an inspection record, receipt, suitability finding, or disposition.

verification.method: For each listed canonical path, sha256sum of the checked-out file was compared to its frozen inspection-source-manifest SHA-256 before direct viewing.
verification.result: 41 of 41 listed canonical paths matched their frozen SHA-256.

direct_viewing_method: view_image per raster canonical path; the two SVGs were rasterized from the verified canonical SVG bytes and viewed individually; the WebM was viewed as individual ffmpeg-rendered frames at 1s and 3s, not as a contact sheet.
